newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: PPC forecasts higher 1996/97 earnings.
newsitem.headline: PPC forecasts higher 1996/97 earnings.

text.p: South African cement and lime producer Pretoria Portland Cement Co Ltd (PPC) said on Thursday it expected higher group earnings in the 1996/97 year following a flat performance in the twelve months to September 30.
"An improvement in the contribution of lime together with marginal growth in cement demand should lead to higher group earnings next year," John Gomersall, the managing director said.
He said the company was well positioned to take advantage of an upturn in both cement and lime marekts.

PPC on Thursday reported earnings before exceptional items unchanged at 464.8 cents a share, below analysts' consensus forecast of 489.7 cents. The dividend lifted marginally to 290 cents from 285 a year ago.

Gomersall said results reflected a tough year in which lime sales declined by 13 percent and margins were hit by an absence of price increases. Costs in the cement division rose due to the establishment of new infrastructure following the disbandment of the cement cartel, he said.

The cartel, which consisted of PPC and competitors, Alpha Ltd and Blue Circle, a Murray and Roberts Holdings Ltd subsidiary, dominated South Africa's cement industry for 25 years. It was dismantled on September 30 this year.
